# Course dependencies

The Flaxon 0.2.7 wheel is built from the reviewed framework changes for this course, including the ORM workflow and CLI setup fix. This is an unreleased repository build, not a claim that 0.2.7 is available on PyPI. Teloce-Py 0.2.6 is pinned alongside it. Run `python scripts/verify_vendor.py` before installation. Keep the wheels with the requirements files when generating a learner project.

The hashes in checksums.json identify the exact files used by the book and chapter verification. Do not silently replace them with newer dependencies while recording.
